architecture.summary: Documents only: the SO-12 release record docs/implementation/self-onboarding-s2-release.md records the release of main 5d1cd816 (the merge of #335, 'Let each account create and name one organization through free access') to the production control plane on 3 November 2026 as step 14. The go-ahead of the owner (about 16:38 UTC, 'Start release'), the image run 41672383252 of the merge (gate 7 of 7, digest sha256:aaae282c..., push step 621 s), the dispatch of 16:38:56 UTC, run 41676347128, deploy dep-dbl0shoae00c73c9s7n0 live at 16:39:58 UTC, the start lines of the new instance, the stop of the old instance 120 s later, health, portal, and signup 200 with the new copy of step 1 (each account can create one organization; sign-in can create it), a 400 for an address that is not valid, no post with an email address, no account, sign-in, MCP call, or registry change, and no warn, error, or fatal line on Render (the control plane and the three tenants) or in the Axiom dataset system-log. Section 1.2 gets the new candidate in its table and a second candidate-change paragraph of 3 November 2026 (10 changed source files, all control plane; the tenant role does not change; the measured static import closure of the tenant application is 129 files, with four changed files in it that a tenant never routes; no migration), section 5 step 4 names sha256:ae982c9a... as the rollback image and shifts the older images down, section 6 item 14 names the digests to keep at the GHCR pruning, and section 7 gets one row. Open for the owner: TENANT_IMAGE and the three live tenants still run sha256:ae982c9a... (optional, the tenant role did not change). Every fact comes from the session that made the release. No source, test, configuration, workflow, migration, or Mermaid block changes; the production architecture is unchanged.
